jobs.description:

**What we offer:**
------------------


At Magna, you can expect an engaging and dynamic environment where you can help to develop industry\-leading automotive technologies. We invest in our employees, providing them with the support and resources they need to succeed. As a member of our global team, you can expect exciting, varied responsibilities as well as a wide range of development prospects. Because we believe that your career path should be as unique as you are.**Group Summary:**
------------------


Magna is more than one of the world’s largest suppliers in the automotive space. We are a mobility technology company built to innovate, with a global, entrepreneurial\-minded team. With 65\+ years of expertise, our ecosystem of interconnected products combined with our complete vehicle expertise uniquely positions us to advance mobility in an expanded transportation landscape.**Job Responsibilities:**

  

The Director, GBS Finance \& Controlling plays a key role in the financial management and strategic planning of Global Business Services (GBS) across North America, Europe, India and China. GBS provides Finance, Accounting and Human Resources services to the Magna organization.  



  

Reporting directly to the VP Finance – Continuous Improvement, this hands\-on leadership role is responsible for strengthening and developing the finance team while directly delivering core finance and controlling activities, including planning, analysis, reporting, controls, pricing, business case development, project controlling and cash flow management. The role partners closely with GBS business leaders to provide practical financial guidance, support informed decision\-making and ensure regulatory compliance and the long\-term financial health of GBS.

 **Your Responsibilities**

 **Financial Planning and Analys**is:

* Lead GBS Business Planning and Forecast process; full cycle (service/project pricing, strategic planning, detail operational plan and forecasting)
* Proper financial analysis, identifying risks and opportunities, and providing recommendations to improve financial performance and profitability.
* Monitor and analyze financial metrics, key performance indicators (KPIs), and financial trends.
* Ensure proper pricing of services/project hours
* Develop and evaluate business cases for various projects, providing clear financial assumptions, scenario analyses and recommendations.
* Lead project controlling activities, including budget tracking, variance analysis, financial performance monitoring and reporting.

 **Financial Reporting and Control**:

* Preparation of accurate and timely financial statements, reports, and presentations for various stakeholders; attesting the financials properly reflect the business performance
* Ensure compliance with accounting principles, guidelines, and regulatory requirements.
* Establish and maintain effective internal controls to safeguard company assets.
* Strategic Financial Leadership:
* Provide strategic insights and financial expertise to support key decision\-making processes.
* Build strong partnerships with GBS business leaders and cross\-functional teams, developing a deep understanding of operations to evaluate business proposals, investments and potential acquisitions and provide practical, informed financial guidance.

 **Cash Flow Management**:

* Manage cash flow, optimize working capital, and ensure adequate liquidity.

 **Team Leadership and Development**:

* Strengthen, lead and develop a global team of financial professionals, providing clear direction, guidance and hands\-on support.
* Foster a culture of excellence, integrity, and continuous improvement within the finance department.
* Identify talent gaps and develop succession plans to ensure the long\-term success of the team.

 **Who we are looking fo**r

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* Proven experience in a senior financial management role, preferably within manufacturing, automotive or a shared services environment.
* Strong knowledge of financial planning and analysis, financial reporting and internal controls.
* Extensive knowledge of accounting principles, consolidation, cost accounting, transfer pricing, taxation, regulatory compliance and financial management in an international business environment.
* Strong understanding of applicable accounting and reporting frameworks, statutory requirements, direct and indirect tax compliance, and financial statement and regulatory report preparation across jurisdictions.
* Exceptional analytical and problem\-solving capability, with the ability to translate financial information into actionable business insights.
* Strong systems proficiency, including Excel, PowerPoint, data warehouse tools, OneStream and SAP.
* Proven leadership and people management capability, including experience developing high\-performing finance teams.
* Ability to communicate and present effectively to senior executives and board members.

 **Your preferred qualifications**


* MBA or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting or a related field.
* Experience supporting a global shared services organization across multiple regions and jurisdictions.
* Advanced proficiency with OneStream, SAP, Excel, PowerPoint and data warehouse environments.

jobs.title: Director, Product & Strategy
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Director, Product \& Strategy
  

**Location:** Hybrid (3 days per week) in Toronto / Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada.
  

Candidates must reside in Toronto or the GTA and be legally authorized to work in Canada.  

**Travel:** Approximately 10\-20%  

**Employment Type:** Permanent, Full\-Time  

**Hiring Timeline:** Immediate  

**Reporting Line:** Head of Tech Delivery
  

**Existing Vacancy:** Yes. This posting is for an existing vacancy.
  

**Application Deadline:** Open until filled. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.  

  

**Salary Range:**
  

$140,000 \- $160,000 CAD base per year, plus 15% bonus eligibility.
  

  

**About Fulfillment IQ**


Fulfillment IQ (FIQ) is a supply chain technology and consulting company helping retailers, brands, and 3PLs solve complex fulfillment and logistics challenges.


Our work spans three core practices: Supply Chain Consulting, Technology Delivery \& Transformation, and Implementation. We help customers assess and design supply\-chain strategies, select and implement technology, modernize fulfillment operations, and build technology solutions that solve complex operational challenges.

 **The Opportunity**


We are looking for a Director, Product \& Strategy to lead our Tech Delivery practice across both sides of the house: the internal teams that build, and the client relationships that fund and shape the work. This is a hands\-on leadership role for someone who is equally comfortable in a client boardroom shaping strategy and in a delivery stand\-up unblocking a team.


You will own the arc of a client engagement end to end: understanding the business problem, shaping the solution strategy, and directing the cross\-functional team that delivers it, all while continuously deepening and expanding the client relationship. You will also help incubate Fulfillment IQ's own internal innovation products, applying the same product discipline to what we build for ourselves.

 **What You’ll Do**

**Client \& Relationship Leadership**

* Own the client relationship as the senior point of contact for assigned clients, building trust with stakeholders from operators to executives.
* Capture and translate client needs into clearly framed problems and solution strategies, translating business goals into delivery roadmaps.
* Grow and expand accounts by identifying new opportunities, shaping proposals and statements of work, and converting successful delivery into expanded scope and long\-term partnership.
* Manage expectations, scope, risks, and escalations proactively, keeping engagements healthy commercially and operationally.

**Delivery \& Team Leadership**

* Lead and mentor cross\-functional delivery teams, product managers, business analysts, UX designers, DevOps engineers, developers (front\-end, back\-end, full\-stack), and tech leads.
* Direct delivery across engagements, planning, resourcing, quality, timelines, and budgets, and holding teams accountable to outcomes.
* Establish delivery standards, ways of working, and reusable practices that raise quality and predictability across the practice.
* Attract and develop talent, coaching leads, growing capability, and building a team people want to be part of.

**Product \& Solution Strategy**

* Shape solution architectures and product strategies that fit each client's operations, budget, and roadmap.
* Incubate Fulfillment IQ's internal innovation products, owning discovery, prioritization, and delivery of what we build for our own IP and platforms.
* Translate supply chain and fulfillment technology trends into practical recommendations and differentiated offerings.
* Partner closely with sales, partnerships, and leadership to align solutions with market opportunity.

 **What You'll Bring**

* 8\+ years of relevant experience, including leadership of technology delivery, product, or professional\-services teams (services, consulting, systems\-integration, or product backgrounds all welcome).
* Proven ability to manage senior client relationships and grow accounts, turning delivery success into expanded scope and revenue.
* Strong command of software delivery: product management, requirements, UX, and engineering across the full stack, plus modern DevOps and agile practices.
* Experience shaping solution strategy and translating ambiguous business problems into clear, deliverable roadmaps.
* A track record of leading and developing cross\-functional teams and setting delivery standards.
* Supply chain, fulfillment, logistics, WMS/OMS/TMS, or e\-commerce technology experience strongly preferred.
* Product ownership instincts: comfortable driving internal innovation products from idea to launch.
* Excellent communication and executive presence; able to move fluidly between strategy conversations and hands\-on delivery.
* Bachelor's degree in a related field, or equivalent experience; based in the US or Canada and able to work on a hybrid schedule.

 **Skills and Competencies**  

**Required Skills**

* Client \& stakeholder management: building and expanding senior relationships and negotiating scope.
* Delivery \& program management: planning, resourcing, budgeting, risk management, and on\-time execution across concurrent engagements.
* Solution \& product strategy: framing ambiguous business problems and translating them into architectures and roadmaps.
* Cross\-functional team leadership: directing product, BA, UX, engineering, and DevOps talent.
* Software delivery lifecycle fluency: agile/scrum, requirements, UX, and full\-stack engineering across front\-end, backend, and DevOps.
* Commercial acumen: proposals, statements of work, estimation, and account growth.
* Executive communication \& presentation: clear, credible, and persuasive with technical and business audiences.
* Product ownership: prioritization, discovery, and driving products from concept to launch.

**Good\-to\-Have Skills**

* Supply chain / fulfillment domain: WMS, OMS, TMS, order manag

jobs.title: Part-Time Chief Financial Officer (CFO)
jobs.description:
**The Arrangement:**

* **Time commitment:** 1 day (8 hours) per week. Potential to expand an additional day per week.
* **Location:** Our Niagara Region office
* **Schedule:** Flexible, with days and hours to be agreed upon
* **Compensation:** $84/hour based on experience
* **Additional compensation and benefits:** potential eligibility for benefits, employer\-matched RRSP contributions, and other arrangements, subject to discussion

**Company Overview:**

We are an established, Niagara\-based general contracting and construction management company serving a diverse range of clients and projects throughout Southern Ontario. Our business is built on strong relationships, sound construction management, financial discipline and a commitment to delivering quality projects. We have a young, driven leadership team and are focused on building a strong foundation for the company’s continued growth and long\-term success.

We operate an integrated Sage and Procore project accounting and management system. We are looking for a finance leader who understands how to leverage these systems to strengthen job\-cost reporting, work\-in\-progress (WIP) analysis, forecasting and management decision\-making.

**The Opportunity:**

We are seeking an experienced Chartered Professional Accountant (CPA) to join our team in a part\-time CFO capacity, working approximately one to two days per week from our Niagara office. You will work directly alongside our leadership team, sharing your experience, strengthening financial oversight, and helping develop the financial reporting and management practices that support the company’s continued success.

*This position may be particularly appealing to someone who is recently retired, approaching retirement, working independently as a consultant, or currently holding a part\-time position and looking for an additional opportunity to contribute their expertise.*

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Financial Reporting and Oversight**

* Oversee the preparation and review of monthly financial statements and management reports
* Coordinate annual financial statements and work with external accountants and auditors as required
* Review accounting procedures, internal controls, and financial reporting processes
* Provide financial insight and guidance to leadership team

**2\. Construction Accounting and Job Costing**

* Review of work\-in\-progress (WIP) schedules and percentages\-of\-completion reporting
* Oversee job\-cost reporting, project profitability analysis, and cost\-to\-complete forecasting.
* Review project budgets, committed costs, estimated costs to complete, and projected margins.
* Help identify financial risks and emerging project issues before they become problems.
* Support accurate reporting of project profitability across both construction management and stipulated\-price contracting work.

**3\. Sage and Procore Systems Integration**

* Understand and leverage our integrated Sage and Procore project accounting and management system
* Ensure project\-level financial information is accurately reflected in accounting reports and management financial statements.
* Work with accounting and project management staff to improve the flow, accuracy, and consistency of financial data between systems.
* Develop reliable reporting processes that connect project budgets, commitments, actual costs, forecasts, WIP, and cash flow.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting, controls, and system utilization to support better financial and operational decisions.

**4\. Cash Flow and Working Capital Management**

* Prepare and review cash flow forecasts and cash flow reporting.
* Monitor working capital, accounts receivable, accounts payable, and collections.
* Provide oversight of construction holdbacks, statutory payment obligations, and lien\-related financial processes.
* Help improve cash flow visibility and financial planning across the business.

**5\. Construction Legislation and Compliance**

* Maintain a working knowledge of Ontario’s Construction Act, including lien rights, statutory holdbacks, and prompt\-payment requirements.
* Understand the legislative reforms introduced through Bill 142 and their implications for Ontario construction businesses.
* Advise management on relevant financial compliance requirements and construction\-industry best practices.

**6\. Management Reporting and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Develop and monitor meaningful financial and operational KPIs.
* Provide clear reporting on gross profit, overhead, profitability, cash flow, WIP, and project performance.
* Help management understand the numbers behind business performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Support budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, and strategic decision\-making.
* Provide concise, practical financial reporting that enables the leadership team to identify issues and make timely, informed decisions.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* CPA designation (formerly CA, CMA, or CGA).
* Significant experience in a senior accounting, controller, finance director, or CFO role.
* Direct experience with general contracting, construction management, or the construction industry.
* Strong understanding of construction accounting, WIP, job costing, holdbacks, and cash flow management
* Familiarity with Ontario’s Construction Act and the legislative reforms associated with Bill 142\.
* Experience with Sage accounting systems and construction project\-management platforms.
* Experience with integrated accounting and project management systems, ideally Sage and Procore, and the ability to turn project data into reliable financial reporting.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate financial information clearly to non\-financial managers.
* A practical, hands\-on approach and the ability to work effectively with a young, driven leadership tea

Pay: $84\.00 per hour

**Headwaters Health Care Centre. One Community, Caring Together.**
------------------------------------------------------------------


At **Headwaters Health Care Centre,** we are proud to serve our community with compassion, accountability, and teamwork. We are seeking a **Director, Finance and Health Records** who is motivated by purpose, values collaboration, and wants to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting.


**About the Role**


Reporting to the Vice President, Corporate Services and Chief Financial Officer, this senior leadership role provides strategic and operational oversight for Finance, Health Records, Materials Management, and hospital‑owned medical office buildings. The Director plays a critical role in advancing financial sustainability, strengthening data‑informed decision‑making, and ensuring the integrity and accessibility of health information that supports high‑quality patient care.


As a trusted partner to clinical and corporate leaders, the Director leads core financial functions including budgeting, forecasting, financial reporting, audits, procurement, and internal controls, while also championing excellence in health information management, privacy, and digital health optimization. The role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to organizational strategy, quality improvement, and collaboration across the broader health system, while supporting the operational and financial performance of commercial rental facilities located on hospital property.


This is an ideal opportunity for a principled, forward‑thinking leader who enjoys working in a dynamic environment, values collaboration, and is passionate about using financial and information stewardship to enable excellent care.


**What You’ll Do**


* Provide strategic leadership for financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and audits
* Champion excellence by leading and supporting high‑quality health records, privacy, data integrity, and digital health systems
* Oversee procurement and materials management in alignment with public‑sector best practices and with a focus on stewardship and transparency
* Manage the financial and operational performance of hospital‑owned medical office buildings
* Partner with leaders to assess risks, develop business cases, and drive continuous improvement
* Support Board, committee, and external reporting relationships with clarity and accountability
* Lead, mentor, and develop high‑performing teams, fostering engagement, growth and building strong succession and talent pipelines
  

**What You Bring**


You are a principled and collaborative leader who brings both professional expertise and a strong commitment to public service and patient‑centred care.


* A commitment to public service and patient‑centred care, grounded in integrity, accountability, and collaboration
* Progressive senior‑level financial leadership experience in a hospital or complex health‑care environment
* A CPA designation, with strong expertise in financial planning, reporting, audits, and stewardship of public resources
* The ability to translate financial, clinical, and operational data into meaningful insights that support decision‑making
* Experience leading or supporting large‑scale information system implementations and digital optimization initiatives
* A people‑centred leadership style, with a proven ability to engage, develop, and inspire high‑performing teams
* Strong judgment, analytical thinking, and comfort navigating complexity and change
* A collaborative mindset, with experience working in unionized environments and partnering across the health system
  

  

**Hours of Work:** 37\.5 hours per week, Monday to Friday
  

  

**Hiring Salary Range:** $160,602 \- $188,955  

  



We are currently hiring for an existing vacancy.


**Why Headwaters?**
  

  

At **Headwaters Health Care Centre**, you’ll be part of a purpose‑driven organization where your leadership directly supports patient care and community well‑being. We offer the opportunity to make a meaningful impact in a community hospital setting while working alongside dedicated, values‑driven professionals.
  

  

You’ll join a collaborative leadership team committed to accountability, continuous improvement, and thoughtful stewardship of public resources. At Headwaters, your expertise will be valued, your voice will matter, and your work will contribute to a trusted, high‑quality health system that serves today’s needs while planning responsibly for the future.  



We offer a wide range of employee perks, for information on our comprehensive benefits package, please visit **Headwaters Health Care Centre \- Careers at Headwaters** .
  

  

We thank all those who apply but only those individuals selected for further consideration will be contacted.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is an inclusive and equal opportunity employer and supports the compliance of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). If you have a need for an accommodation, please contact Human Resources so that appropriate arrangements can be made.
  

  

Headwaters Health Care Centre is a smoke\-free facility. Smoking is not permitted on hospital properties. We thank everyone who works at or visits our hospitals for respecting this healthy initiative. We are also a scent\-free environment for all employees and visitors.
